$comment: Photo slots. beforeAfter keeps its illustrations by the owner's choice (a src here replaces one). Drop real, compressed images (WebP/JPEG, ~1600px wide) into public/photos/ and set src to '/photos/<file>'. While src is null, a labeled placeholder shows so nothing looks finished that isn't. Write alt text that describes the actual photo.

heroVideo.$comment: Homepage hero background video: a 15-20s seamless loop, no audio. Put the files in public/videos/ at these paths and rebuild. Each file is used only if it exists, so until they're there the hero keeps its normal background. 'mobile' is a portrait 9:16 crop served to screens under 768px; 'desktop' is 16:9. The posters are the first frame of each encode (JPEG). Specs and ffmpeg commands: README > Hero video.
